# Keybinds

<!-- generated by scripts/gen-keybinds-doc.sh; do not edit by hand -->

Every binding below comes from `~/.config/niri/keybinds.kdl`; the shell section is
generated from the `IpcHandler` targets in `home/.config/ringo-shell/shell.qml`.
Regenerate with `scripts/gen-keybinds-doc.sh` after changing either file
(`scripts/gen-keybinds-doc.sh --check` fails while this document is stale).

`Mod` is Super / the Windows key.

## Keybinds

| Keys | Action |
| :--- | :--- |
| `Mod+Slash` | Keybinds (searchable) — `spawn-sh "ringo-shell call keybinds toggle"` |
| `Mod+Shift+Slash` | `show-hotkey-overlay` |

## Shell & launchers

| Keys | Action |
| :--- | :--- |
| `Mod+V` | Clipboard Menu — `spawn-sh "ringo-shell call cliphist toggle"` |
| `Mod+Shift+C` | Wipe Clipboard — `spawn-sh "ringo-shell call cliphist wipe"` |
| `Mod+Return` | Open a Terminal: foot — `spawn "foot"` |
| `Mod+grave` | Scratchpad Terminal — `spawn-sh "scratchpad.sh"` |
| `Mod+P` | Pick Screen Color — `spawn-sh "color-picker.sh"` |
| `Mod+D` | Run Application Menu: ringo-shell — `spawn-sh "ringo-shell call appLauncher toggle"` |
| `Mod+E` | Open File Manager: thunar — `spawn "thunar"` |
| `Mod+B` | Open Browser: firefox — `spawn "firefox"` |
| `Mod+Ctrl+C` | Control Center — `spawn-sh "ringo-shell call controlCenter toggle"` |
| `Mod+Ctrl+B` | Mini Dashboard — `spawn-sh "ringo-shell call miniDashboard toggle"` |
| `Mod+Ctrl+W` | Wallpaper Switcher — `spawn-sh "ringo-shell call wallpaperSwitcher toggle"` |
| `Mod+Shift+P` | Power Menu — `spawn-sh "ringo-shell call powerMenu toggle"` |
| `Mod+Alt+B` | Toggle Bar — `spawn-sh "ringo-shell call bar toggle"` |

## Screenshots & media

| Keys | Action |
| :--- | :--- |
| `Print` | `screenshot` |
| `Ctrl+Print` | `screenshot-screen` |
| `Alt+Print` | `screenshot-window` |
| `Mod+F11` | Record Screen — `spawn-sh "record.sh"` |

## System

| Keys | Action |
| :--- | :--- |
| `Mod+Escape` | `toggle-keyboard-shortcuts-inhibit` |
| `Mod+Shift+E` | `quit` |
| `XF86AudioRaiseVolume` | `spawn-sh "wpctl set-volume -l 1 @DEFAULT_AUDIO_SINK@ 2%+"` |
| `XF86AudioLowerVolume` | `spawn-sh "wpctl set-volume @DEFAULT_AUDIO_SINK@ 2%-"` |
| `XF86AudioMute` | `spawn-sh "wpctl set-mute @DEFAULT_AUDIO_SINK@ toggle"` |
| `XF86AudioMicMute` | `spawn-sh "wpctl set-mute @DEFAULT_AUDIO_SOURCE@ toggle"` |
| `XF86AudioPlay` | `spawn-sh "ringo-shell call media playPause"` |
| `XF86AudioPause` | `spawn-sh "ringo-shell call media playPause"` |
| `XF86AudioStop` | `spawn-sh "ringo-shell call media stop"` |
| `XF86AudioPrev` | `spawn-sh "ringo-shell call media prev"` |
| `XF86AudioNext` | `spawn-sh "ringo-shell call media next"` |
| `XF86MonBrightnessUp` | `spawn-sh "ringo-shell call brightness up"` |
| `XF86MonBrightnessDown` | `spawn-sh "ringo-shell call brightness down"` |

## Shell Commands (IPC)

Commands the shell exposes over IPC, called as `ringo-shell call <target> <function>`.

| Target | Functions |
| :--- | :--- |
| `cliphist` | `toggle` `open` `hide` `wipe` |
| `controlCenter` | `toggle` `open` `hide` |
| `miniDashboard` | `toggle` `open` `hide` |
| `appLauncher` | `toggle` `open` `hide` `search` `launch` |
| `wallpaperSwitcher` | `toggle` `open` `hide` |
| `wallpaper` | `set` `reload` `setMode` `next` `slideshow` `interval` `status` |
| `nightLight` | `toggle` `on` `off` `force` `status` |
| `quietMode` | `toggle` `on` `off` `status` |
| `keybinds` | `toggle` `open` `hide` `search` |
| `doctor` | `check` |
| `notify` | `post` |
| `powerMenu` | `toggle` `open` `hide` |
| `recordMenu` | `toggle` `open` `hide` |
| `bar` | `toggle` `open` `hide` |
| `calendar` | `toggle` `open` `hide` |
| `weather` | `toggle` `open` `hide` |
| `lock` | `unlock` `lock` |
| `media` | `playPause` `next` `prev` `stop` |
| `brightness` | `up` `down` `step` |
